garden_read_live.dashboard: Zen Garden — saved collection tools available

limits: Live checks used native game state and the actual sold-out routine. No shop purchase was submitted through the game UI.
Mushroom/Aquarium records and coordinates were inspected in the saved collection; their rendered appearance was not captured.
The 20 local GOTY achievement flags are edited; Steam-account achievements are outside this editor.
Garden additions/moves and player-data/achievement changes require Main Menu. Identity, strings and Zombatar data are preserved.

A test-only return-to-menu helper initially used the wrong register and caused a test crash. It was corrected to the verified ECX convention and the final garden trial passed after restart. This helper is not shipped.
